projectDescription: Almendra is an AI-powered company brain platform that connects your knowledge sources, documents, and workflows into a single governed intelligence layer your team and AI agents can query instantly.
keyFeatures: Connect knowledge sources (Notion, Confluence, Google Drive, GitHub, Jira, Zendesk)
AI-powered Q&A with source citations and confidence scores
REST API and MCP server for agent integration
Role-based access control and permission-aware retrieval
Tamper-evident audit log for every knowledge access
Knowledge gap detection and continuous improvement
Persistent memory — decisions and approvals build reusable context
Support for multiple LLM backends (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini)
publicApiSurface: POST /api/v1/query — Ask a question, get a cited answer with confidence score
POST /api/v1/search — Raw vector search returning document chunks with relevance scores
POST /api/v1/ingest — Ingest a URL or raw text into the knowledge base
GET /api/v1/sources — List all connected knowledge sources
MCP server — query_knowledge, list_sources, search_documents tools for any MCP-compatible agent
